paper.title: Get Experience from Practice: LLM Agents with Record & Replay
paper.central_claim: AgentRR 通过记录 agent 交互轨迹、总结为多层经验与 check function、并在相似任务中回放，来同时改善 agent 的可靠性、隐私、成本与执行性能。

signatures.object: agent 的经验库：多层经验(高层流程描述+低层参数化脚本/API 序列)与对应 check function
signatures.information: 记录人类或 agent 的环境交互轨迹(状态+元操作)；回放时 LLM 看到所选经验与当前环境/任务；check function 作可信基
signatures.operation: record→summary(把轨迹摘要成多层经验+生成 check function，先回放轨迹验证可复现)→replay(选最低层且成功率最高的经验，LLM 实例化动作，check function 拦截违规动作)
signatures.output: 可版本化、可共享的经验与 check function
signatures.conditions: 重复性、流程相似的任务(表单、预订、购买)；LLM 须能把经验实例化
signatures.feedback: 轨迹本身(人类演示或强模型成功执行)及回放成败；来源可为用户、大模型、受信/不受信模型
signatures.selection_rule_data: 摘要阶段回放验证可复现；回放时按成功率选层级；经验库评分/审计(设想)
signatures.persistence: 经验库(JSON/图数据库)含任务描述、创建者、版本、评分、审计状态(设想)
signatures.later_use: 后续相似任务检索并回放；高频任务增量精炼(设想)
signatures.claimed_effect: 可靠性、隐私、成本、性能四项提升(论证性，无测量)
signatures.failure_boundary: 经验完整性、回放鲁棒性、泛化-安全折中、适用范围(作者自列)；动态 HTML、弹窗致回放不稳

gap.author_gap: LLM agent 的幻觉、隐私、运营成本、执行速度四个挑战；对齐/蒸馏/剪枝等模型侧方案只能缓解；传统 R&R 不泛化，纯 LLM agent 不可靠。
gap.checked_gap: 成立但宽：被改变的非权重对象明确(把轨迹编译为多层经验+check function 并回放)；与 MobileGPT、UFO2、Workflow Use、browser-use 的区别靠作者描述，缺原文核对。

assessment.evidence_level_note: No EVIDENCE.md level: the paper reports no measured output, score or cost for AgentRR (opus:O02); levels start at an observed task gain (cal-dev 1112.5309 precedent). Null, not 'none'.
assessment.strongest_supported_claim: A design that records traces, verifies them by replay, summarizes them into low-level parameterized scripts and high-level procedural guidance with check functions, stores them for sharing and replays the lowest workable level, illustrated by one qualitative form-filling walkthrough. Claimed gains in reliability, privacy, cost and speed — and the §6 claim of an 'evaluation' (opus:O01) — have no supporting measurement.
unresolved: Any measured benefit; level definitions (opus:O06); check-function soundness; comparison with MobileGPT/Workflow Use.
